units.name: Obsidian Obelisk
units.description: Suspended in the air by ancient ropes and shimmering with dark power, the Obsidian Shards drifts ominously above the earth. Yet one thing is certain, when its power stirs, it conjures nightmarish spawns capable of bringing entire civilizations to ruin.

techs.name: Ehecailacocozcatl
techs.description: All units move faster.

techs.name: Mayahuel's Maguey
techs.description: Human Soldiers return a portion of their cost upon dying.

techs.name: Bone Shards of Mictlan
techs.description: Myth units return favor upon death.

techs.name: Hummingbird's Beak
techs.description: Infantry deal bonus damage against other infantry.

techs.name: Atlatl of Ehecatl
techs.description: Ranged soldiers and buildings shoot faster.

techs.name: Xiuhcoatl
techs.description: Myth Units deal additional damage to other Myth Units.

techs.name: Great Tzompantli
techs.description: Towers are cheaper to build.

techs.name: Craft Workshop
techs.description: Increases Gold dropped off to this Calpulli by 15%.nConvert 20% of other resource types dropped off at this Calpulli to Gold.nYou can only have 1 of this Calpulli type.

techs.name: Lumber Outpost
techs.description: Increases Wood dropped off to this Calpulli by 15%.nAdds a projectile attack and garrison space for 5 units.nYou can only have 1 of this Calpulli type.

techs.name: Livestock Pen
techs.description: Increases Food dropped off to this Calpulli by 15%.nPeriodically spawns livestock as resources are deposited.nYou can only have 1 of this Calpulli type.

techs.name: Brokk's Primancy
techs.description: Improves the attack of all human soldiers, heroes, and myth units.

techs.name: The Iron Fortress
techs.description: Improves human soldier, hero, and myth unit resistance to hack attacks, such as swords.

techs.name: The Eternal Pillar
techs.description: Improves human soldier, hero, and myth unit resistance to pierce attacks, such as arrows.

godpowers.name: Bolt
godpowers.rollover: A bolt of lightning from the sky strikes down any single military unit.

godpowers.name: Sentinel
godpowers.rollover: Target your or an ally’s Town Center, Village Center, or Fortress to protect it with stone guardians.

godpowers.name: Lure
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to erect a special stone which draws animals to it and spawns chickens. The Lure summons more food in later ages, and Villagers can drop off food at the Lure.

godpowers.name: Restoration
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to heal units and repair buildings, siege weapons, and ships belonging to you or your allies.

godpowers.name: Ceasefire
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to prevent every player from fighting and slow the construction of ranged fortifications for a short period of time.

godpowers.name: Pestilence
godpowers.rollover: Target an enemy town to infect it with plague. The Pestilence prevents buildings from firing projectiles and slows unit production.

godpowers.name: Underworld Invasion
godpowers.rollover: Sacrifice all standing Town and Village Centers to resurrect up to 25 + 25 per Town Center up to a maximum of 125 fallen human soldiers. Settlements cannot be repopulated for some time.

godpowers.name: Bronze
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to encase your soldiers, myth units, and ships with bronze, reducing their vulnerability in combat.

godpowers.name: Curse
godpowers.rollover: Target near enemy soldiers to turn several of their units into Pigs.

godpowers.name: Underworld Passage
godpowers.rollover: Select two locations on the map to create entrances to the Underworld through which units can move.

godpowers.name: Plenty
godpowers.rollover: Select a location to erect this great Vault. The bounty of the gods will flow into your coffers as long as you control it.

godpowers.name: Lightning Storm
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to call down an electric storm from Olympus whose power increases over time. Strong against groups of enemy units.

godpowers.name: Earthquake
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to shatter nearby enemy buildings. The epicenter of the earthquake inflicts the most damage.

godpowers.name: Wither
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to wither berries, farms, and trees, rendering the terrain sterile for a short period of time.

godpowers.name: Arcadian Meadow
godpowers.rollover: Target an area to temporarily turn it into a peaceful meadow. Units and buildings inside the meadow cannot attack.

godpowers.name: Communal Hearth
godpowers.rollover: Summon a hearth that increases Villager gather rate and converts enemy units.

godpowers.name: Rain
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere to make all of your Villagers gather Food from Farms faster, and fishing ships gather Food from fish faster.

godpowers.name: Prosperity
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere to make all of your Villagers and Trade Caravans gather Gold faster.

godpowers.name: Vision
godpowers.rollover: Target a region of the map to be temporarily revealed.

godpowers.name: Eclipse
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to turn day to night, improving the abilities of your myth units and increasing the rate at which your Monuments generate Favor.

godpowers.name: Shifting Sands
godpowers.rollover: Target your own or allied units, and then target the location where you wish to teleport them.

godpowers.name: Plague of Serpents
godpowers.rollover: Target a location on the map where dangerous Serpents will rise from the ground or sea and protect that area from your enemies.

godpowers.name: Locust Swarm
godpowers.rollover: Target a path of destruction. Summons a plague of locusts that attacks enemy units and buildings, devouring Farms, livestock, and Berry Bushes.

godpowers.name: Ancestors
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to awaken ancestral soldiers or ships to fight again for a short time.

godpowers.name: Citadel
godpowers.rollover: Select a Town Center belonging to you or an ally to transform it into a mighty, defensive Citadel, which trains units and researches technologies faster.

godpowers.name: Son of Osiris
godpowers.rollover: Target your Pharaoh to transform him into a super-empowering, lightning-wielding demigod.

godpowers.name: Meteor
godpowers.rollover: Target an enemy area to bombard with burning rocks from the heavens. Strong against buildings, moderately effective against units.

godpowers.name: Tornado
godpowers.rollover: Target near an enemy to send a cyclone that will suck their buildings and units up into the sky – but stay out of its way.

godpowers.name: Dwarven Mine
godpowers.rollover: Select a location to create a new Gold Mine that has more Gold and is gathered faster if used in later ages.

godpowers.name: Spy
godpowers.rollover: Target an enemy unit to secretly see what it sees.

godpowers.name: Great Hunt
godpowers.rollover: Target a group of wild animals to greatly multiply their numbers. If there are none, Odin will summon a small amount. Gets more powerful each age.

godpowers.name: Gullinbursti
godpowers.rollover: Target one of your Town Centers (or your allies') to summon and command Freyr's golden boar Gullinbursti to defend the area. Gullinbursti becomes stronger each age.

godpowers.name: Forest Fire
godpowers.rollover: Target a forest to burn it to smoldering embers, damaging nearby units and buildings.

godpowers.name: Healing Spring
godpowers.rollover: Target a location on the map to create a spring that will heal all nearby friendly units. The spring cannot be destroyed, but can be taken over by enemy forces.

godpowers.name: Undermine
godpowers.rollover: Target a path of destruction along which to damage enemy buildings. Walls and towers instantly collapse, and other buildings take considerable damage.

godpowers.name: Asgardian Bastion
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to summon a foundation that will materialize into a spectral Hill Fort when fully constructed. Builds faster in later ages.

godpowers.name: Frost
godpowers.rollover: Target near enemy units to freeze them solid for a short period of time. Frozen units cannot move, but are very hard to kill.

godpowers.name: Flaming Weapons
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to cause the weapons of all of your human soldiers and ships to burst into flame, increasing their attack for a short period of time.

godpowers.name: Walking Woods
godpowers.rollover: Target near a forest to animate the trees to attack nearby enemies. The animated trees are strong against buildings and decent against units.

godpowers.name: Tempest
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to unleash a vicious hailstorm, damaging enemies and heavily slowing their attacks and movement.

godpowers.name: Ragnarok
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all of your Gatherers and Dwarves into mighty Heroes of Ragnarok.

godpowers.name: Fimbulwinter
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to summon packs of ferocious wolves to attack enemy Town Centers.

godpowers.name: Nidhogg
godpowers.rollover: Select a location to summon the mighty Norse dragon from his delve beneath the earth.

godpowers.name: Inferno
godpowers.rollover: Target a fiery path of destruction. The great wolf Fenrir will emerge and charge, engulfing enemies in flames before erupting into an apocalyptic inferno of flame and ruin.

godpowers.name: Deconstruction
godpowers.rollover: Target an enemy building to deconstruct it. The target player will get their resources back but lose the building.

godpowers.name: Shockwave
godpowers.rollover: Target a location on the map to send enemy units flying, stunning them for a few seconds.

godpowers.name: Gaia Forest
godpowers.rollover: Select a location to grow a Gaia Forest. Villagers gather wood faster from Gaia Trees.

godpowers.name: Carnivora
godpowers.rollover: Spawns a giant plant that pulls humans and ships in and devours them.

godpowers.name: Valor
godpowers.rollover: Target one of your human units to convert it into a hero and heal it fully.

godpowers.name: Spider Lair
godpowers.rollover: Target an area to place spider eggs which will hatch and burrow. The spiders will devour enemy human soldiers that cross through the area, but eggs can be destroyed before they hatch.

godpowers.name: Traitor
godpowers.rollover: Target an enemy unit to convert it to your side.

godpowers.name: Chaos
godpowers.rollover: Target a group of enemy units to make it temporarily hostile to all.

godpowers.name: Hesperides Tree
godpowers.rollover: Select a location to create a tree that summons some Dryad myth units and can train more.

godpowers.name: Vortex
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to transport all of your military units there.

godpowers.name: Tartarian Gate
godpowers.rollover: Hekate opens a gate to the Underworld that unleashes creatures hostile to all. The gate will destroy any buildings in the vicinity when it is placed.

godpowers.name: Implode
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to do massive damage to nearby units and buildings. This is more powerful when cast near a large number of enemy units.

godpowers.name: Titan Gate
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to place a Titan Gate. Once your Villagers finish clearing the debris, a Titan will emerge.

godpowers.name: Walking Woods
godpowers.rollover: Target near a forest to animate the trees to attack nearby enemies. The animated trees are strong against buildings and decent against units.

godpowers.name: Goatunheim
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all units into tasty Goats. BAAAAAAH!

godpowers.name: Ceasefire
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to prevent every player from fighting and slow the construction of ranged fortifications for a short period of time.

godpowers.name: Walking Woods
godpowers.rollover: Target near a forest to animate the trees to attack nearby enemies. The animated trees are strong against buildings and decent against units.

godpowers.name: Meteor
godpowers.rollover: Target an enemy area to bombard with burning rocks from the heavens. Strong against buildings, moderately effective against units.

godpowers.name: Blessing of Zeus
godpowers.rollover: Target Arkantos to transform him into a super-powered, demi-god.

godpowers.name: Deconstruct Wonder
godpowers.rollover: Target an enemy Wonder to reverse time on it and unbuild it.

godpowers.name: Seed of Gaia
godpowers.rollover: Target a Gaia Pool to grow a Gaia Summoning Tree there.

godpowers.name: Wolf Pack
godpowers.rollover: Target a location on the map where dangerous wolves will spawn and protect that area from your enemies.

godpowers.name: Shockwave
godpowers.rollover: Target a location on the map to send enemy units flying, stunning them for a few seconds.

godpowers.name: Walking Woods
godpowers.rollover: Target near a forest to animate the trees to attack nearby enemies. The animated trees are strong against buildings and decent against units.

godpowers.name: Forest Fire
godpowers.rollover: Target a forest to burn it to smoldering embers, damaging nearby units and buildings.

godpowers.name: Implode
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to do massive damage to nearby units and buildings. This is more powerful when cast near a large number of enemy units.

godpowers.name: Curse of Ra
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to summon packs of Mummies and Minions to attack enemy Town Centers.

godpowers.name: The Peach Blossom Spring
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to create the Peach Blossom Spring, whose resource stockpile grows over time. The Peach Blossom Spring's resources are gathered very quickly, but its stockpile stops growing once a villager starts gathering from it.

godpowers.name: Creation
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to create a number of Clay Peasants that last for a couple of minutes. Spawns more Peasants in later ages.

godpowers.name: Prosperous Seeds
godpowers.rollover: Target 2 Farms to sow the seeds of prosperity. They will produce food faster, heal nearby villagers, and make friendly units on them invisible.

godpowers.name: Lightning Weapons
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to conduct lightning into the weapons of all of your human soldiers, heroes and ships, granting their attacks a chance to stun enemies.

godpowers.name: Earth Wall
godpowers.rollover: Target a friendly building to surround it with earthen walls. Allies can pass through them, but enemies cannot.

godpowers.name: Vanish
godpowers.rollover: Target a group of friendly units to make them invisible for a short time. Attacking will reveal their position.

godpowers.name: Forest Protection
godpowers.rollover: Target a friendly building to protect the surrounding area with Goumang's wood power, which roots enemies and heals allied units.

godpowers.name: Drought
godpowers.rollover: Target an area to spread drought, which makes enemy buildings far easier to destroy, units easier to kill, and prevents all construction and repairs.

godpowers.name: Fei Beasts
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to spawn poisonous Fei Beasts that spread infection to enemies.

godpowers.name: Great Flood
godpowers.rollover: Target a path of destruction for a cataclysmic flood that sweeps away units and annihilates buildings.

godpowers.name: Blazing Prairie
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to open the heavens and set the world on fire. Everything will burn.

godpowers.name: Yinglong's Wrath
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to summon Yinglong, the legendary rain and lightning dragon of China.

godpowers.name: Pandatopia
godpowers.rollover: Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all units into Pandas.

godpowers.name: Yin and Yang (God Blessing)
godpowers.rollover:
Fuxi grants alternating bonuses, which swap every 4 minutes:

• Yin: Peasants and Kuafus gather +10% faster.

• Yang: Human soldiers and siege weapons +10% damage.

godpowers.name: Creator’s Auspice (God Blessing)
godpowers.rollover: Nüwa reduces Peasant cost and improves building hitpoints as you earn Favor.

godpowers.name: Gift of Beasts (God Blessing)
godpowers.rollover: Shennong summons myth units from the next Age at your Temple for free as you earn Favor.

godpowers.name: Solar Shield
godpowers.rollover: Target a unit to make it temporarily nearly invulnerable.

godpowers.name: Kusanagi
godpowers.rollover: Target a location for Susanoo to cast down his sword, Kusanagi. The sword damages nearby enemies and summons a riptide that blasts them skyward.

godpowers.name: New Moon
godpowers.rollover: Target a building to obtain the three most expensive technologies currently available there for free and cause military units to train faster for a short duration.

godpowers.name: Shrine of the Hunt
godpowers.rollover: Target a Shrine to transform it into a Shrine of the Hunt, periodically spawning huntable deer as well as friendly wolves that defend the area.

godpowers.name: Goshinboku
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to summon a Goshinboku tree. The tree's blessing resurrects the owner's myth units as they fall in combat.

godpowers.name: Swampland
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to create a temporary swamp infested with Kappa that will leap out of the water and drown enemy human soldiers.

godpowers.name: Shogun
godpowers.rollover: Target a Daimyo to transform him into an immensely powerful Shogun, who summons Samurai while he fights.

godpowers.name: Smiting Gust
godpowers.rollover: Target a direction in which to unleash an immense gust of wind, blasting military units across the map.

godpowers.name: Thunder Burst
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to unleash earth-shaking shockwaves. Raijin strikes his den-den daiko drums, causing expanding rings of lightning to damage and stun enemies.

godpowers.name: Sacred Gate
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to erect a great Torii Gate which makes your God Powers cheaper and immediately enables you to invoke them once again for free.

godpowers.name: Dragon Typhoon
godpowers.rollover: Target a path of destruction. Watatsumi will descend in dragon form and erupt into a swirling typhoon, tearing through everything in his path.

godpowers.name: Divine Slash
godpowers.rollover: Target a path of destruction. Takemikazuchi will cleave the earth with a colossal katana slash, inflicting massive damage to units and stunning any survivors.

godpowers.name: Ame-no-Ukihashi
godpowers.rollover: Select two locations on the map to create entrances to the Underworld through which units can move.

godpowers.name: Hachiman's Blessing
godpowers.rollover: Target Harumoto or a Daimyo to grant Hachiman's blessing, making them much stronger.

godpowers.name: Blood Pact
godpowers.rollover: Target any unit to grant it immense power for a short duration. When the effect ends, the unit dies, granting you Favor.

godpowers.name: Tailwind
godpowers.rollover: Target a group of friendly units to boost their movement speed for a short duration.

godpowers.name: Obsidian Mirror
godpowers.rollover: Target any player to secretly copy their Archaic Age God Power.

godpowers.name: Lullaby
godpowers.rollover: Target a group of enemies to put them to sleep. Any damage dealt to sleeping units will wake them up immediately.

godpowers.name: Infestation
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to summon an Infested Nest that periodically spawns Scorpions that obey your commands.

godpowers.name: Agave Bloom
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to spawn a sacred Agave. Gather it for Food or let its sacred energy heal your nearby units.

godpowers.name: Earth Monster
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to summon Tlaltecuhtli, the Earth Monster. It erupts from the ground repeatedly to swallow groups of units, trapping them underground before regurgitating survivors.

godpowers.name: Starfall
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to bombard enemies with falling stars. Tzitzimitl star demons occasionally emerge from the craters to fight for you.

godpowers.name: Purge
godpowers.rollover: Target an enemy military unit to mark it for sacrifice. The unit is suspended in the air, and after a short delay, all nearby enemies of the same type are destroyed, up to a total of 1400 resource value.

godpowers.name: Corrupted Ground
godpowers.rollover: Target an area to corrupt the earth. Defeated enemies here will be reborn as vile abominations that fight for you.

godpowers.name: Pillar of Tlálocan
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to call down the Pillar of Tlálocan, obliterating fortifications on impact. The statue remains to defend the area with water strikes until destroyed.

godpowers.name: Volcano
godpowers.rollover: Target a location to raise a mighty Volcano. It obliterates buildings as it rises, and bombards the surrounding area with molten rock.

godpowers.name: Feast of Sustenance
godpowers.rollover: +15% increase in all gather rates, for 15 seconds.
